theorem_title: Sharp-tail bound for the actual all-tiles routine step count
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSumSharpTail.retained_tiles_cost (c m nB : ℕ) (hc : 10 < c) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ9 : θ < 9 / 10) :
    (Light.Sec4.tAllTiles (c * m) m ⌈θ * (m : ℝ)⌉₊ nB : ℝ) ≤
      1600 * ((c : ℝ) * m + 1) *
        ((nB : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((m : ℝ) + 1) *
          ((ThreeSumSharpTail.boxCount c m 0 : ℝ) *
            (((c : ℝ) * m + 1) / (1 - 9 / ((c : ℝ) - 1)) *
              Real.rpow ((4 : ℝ) ^ m) (-ThreeSumSharpTail.sharpSaving c θ)) + 1)) +
          nB + 1) := by sorry
natural_language_statement: Bounds the published natural-number time function tAllTiles at L=cm and t=ceil(theta*m). The bound counts the lengths of the star-box lists actually traversed by the routine, uses their exact binomial enumeration formula, and applies the sharp normalized tail. The bound holds for every number of bands, with explicit constant 1600 and all loop overheads included. Tile-fit, encoding, compiler and reduction costs must still be composed before claiming the final word-RAM runtime.
